cases.title: Live Inferred Speakers

payload.context: A real unexpected call; speaker identities must be inferred from this dialogue.

turns.speaker: unassigned
turns.text: Hi, Omri calling from Salesforce. I had a thought about order lookups.

turns.speaker: unassigned
turns.text: I own service operations. We occasionally check the carrier site, but it is fine for us.

cases.manual_review: Infer seller then buyer. Do not inflate occasional lookups into major pain or urgency.

cases.title: Live Ae Product Question

payload.context: Scheduled technical evaluation. No pricing, architecture or savings are confirmed.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: We can look at connecting the case workspace to the order system.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: How would that actually work with Service Cloud?

cases.manual_review: Answer the direct product question with grounded capabilities and limits, not another generic discovery question.

cases.title: Live Ae Agreement

payload.context: Commercial follow-up. No purchase is yet approved.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: I can send the scoped proposal for your procurement review tomorrow.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Yes, send it tomorrow. I will review it with procurement on Thursday.

cases.manual_review: Close naturally; do not re-sell the proposal, re-confirm agreement or invent purchase commitment.

cases.title: Live Seller Awaits Buyer

payload.context: Live call; the seller just asked a question and the buyer has not replied.

turns.speaker: buyer
turns.text: Order lookups can be annoying.

turns.speaker: seller
turns.text: What tends to make them annoying?

cases.manual_review: WAIT. Do not coach the buyer or supply a fabricated buyer answer.
